baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated preposition before right and left establishes coordinate flanks, while the final plural noun marks multiple groupings.
baseline_models.mechanism: Opposed side branches establish a two-sided field. The reinforcement branch carried by the mapped inventory of ع ز و makes each plural unit a braced cohort, so the verse maps several cohesive blocs around a center rather than an undifferentiated mass.

activation_trace.role: The literal right hand or right side supplies one concrete flank of the bilateral field.
The literal left side opposite the right supplies the counter-flank that completes the layout.
Strengthening one by another supplies internal bracing to each plural cohort; this is a mapping-dependent use of the focus inventory.

changed_reading.before: People stand in groups to the right and left.
changed_reading.after: Several internally braced cohorts flank a shared center from both sides.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The side-pair spans the field, but the plural grouping leaves the people in separate units.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ش م ل inventory holds both all-around inclusion and scattered remnants. Distributed across the explicit right-left axis and locally reinforced, those fragments collectively enclose the center without becoming one social whole.

activation_trace.role: The right-side image extends the fragmented population across one half of the enclosing field.
All-around encompassing supplies the emergent enclosure produced by occupation of both sides.
Scattered small remnants supply the discontinuous, factional texture within that enclosure.
Reinforcement gives each fragment local cohesion while preserving separation between cohorts.

changed_reading.before: A crowd is distributed around the center.
changed_reading.after: Locally cohesive but mutually separate circles enclose the center; total coverage does not become social unity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah supplies face-to-face orientation and rapid approach toward the addressee. The focus ayah then distributes that directed motion into right-side and left-side cohorts, converting a static layout into active convergence on a human center.

activation_trace.role: The literal right side supplies one lateral stream around the approached center.
The opposed left side supplies the matching lateral stream.
Mutual reinforcement keeps the converging people legible as distinct cohorts rather than one flow.
Literal confrontation places the crowd face-to-face with the addressee and supplies the scene's center.
Rapid forward approach supplies kinetic pressure into the bilateral arrangement.

structural_cues: 70:37 continues the spatial specification of the people described in 70:36, so its two side phrases remain centered on the second-person addressee.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confrontation, forward haste, two flanks, and plural cohorts; I infer that the movement converges on the addressee and then distributes laterally. A live alternative is a stationary audience already ranked on both sides.

changed_reading.before: Several cohorts occupy static positions on two sides.
changed_reading.after: Several directed cohorts press toward the addressee and split into matching lateral streams around him.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the plural cohorts, every person is separately predicated with hope for entry into sheltered ease. The collective shell is penetrated by one-person-at-a-time desire: the group becomes a pressure bloc made of private admission claims rather than evidence of shared belonging.

activation_trace.role: Gathering a scattered whole supplies the social unity that the next ayah puts under pressure.
Mutual reinforcement supplies the outward cohesion of each cohort.
Hope lodged in the heart supplies the private motive operating inside the public crowd.
Total inclusion distributes the question across every member, preventing the cohort from answering as one body.
Literal entry supplies an admission threshold toward which each private claim is aimed.
The tree-sheltered garden supplies the protected interior desired by those currently outside it.
Good condition and benefit specify the privileged state each claimant expects to enter.

structural_cues: 70:38 shifts from the plural cohorts of 70:37 to the distributive singular 'every person among them.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies group form, distributive totality, hope, entry, garden, and ease; I infer competition at an admission threshold. A live alternative is that the distributive grammar questions each person without characterizing relations within the groups.

changed_reading.before: The cohorts look like solidaristic social units.
changed_reading.after: Their outward cohesion conceals individualized claims: each member crowds the threshold for private admission into privilege.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus uses one bodily pair, right and left, to imply complete lateral coverage. The later plural risings and settings expand orientation into repeated horizon points, so what looked all-enclosing at human scale becomes one local axis inside a larger ordered field.

activation_trace.role: The right-side image supplies one pole of a body-relative local axis.
The opposite left side completes that apparently exhaustive local pair.
Light rising from the east supplies a horizon-scale orientation beyond the crowd's bodily right.
Sunset and west supply the opposed horizon pole, repeated in the verse's plural frame.

structural_cues: 70:40 answers the singular right-left pair with plural risings and settings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired directional imagery and plural horizons; I infer a scale contrast that relativizes the crowd's claim to surround. A live alternative is a directional parallel with no polemical reduction of the local scene.

changed_reading.before: By occupying both sides, the crowd appears to command the whole field.
changed_reading.after: Its bilateral surround is only a body-relative claim to totality, dwarfed by the many cosmic horizons that order the field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory lets the cohorts look strong because members reinforce one another. Context then supplies effective capability, substitution of one thing for another, and the denied possibility of outstripping that agency. Cohesion is recast as the visible boundary of replaceable population units, not durable power.

activation_trace.role: Strengthening one member by another supplies the cohorts' apparent collective resilience.
Capability that reaches effective action supplies the overriding agency against which cohort strength is measured.
One thing standing in another's place turns bounded cohorts into substitutable units.
Escape beyond a pursuer names the possibility explicitly denied, closing off numerical cohesion as a defense.

structural_cues: 70:41 keeps the same third-person plural population in view while moving from its cohort arrangement to possible substitution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus-side reinforcement, effective capability, substitution, and denied outstripping; I infer that crowd cohesion is provisional and cannot block replacement. A live alternative is species-level replacement with no emphasis on cohort topology.

changed_reading.before: The groups look stronger because each member braces the others.
changed_reading.after: Their apparent strength exposes bounded, substitutable units under an agency they cannot outpace.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rapid approach around the addressee is echoed by rapid movement toward an upright marker, followed by submission and brokenness. The focus becomes a hinge between two convergences: the present one retains factional lateral choice, while the later one collapses every flank into a single imposed vector and reverses confident posture.

activation_trace.role: The literal right side supplies one self-organized flank in the present convergence.
The opposed left side supplies the other self-organized flank.
Mutual reinforcement supplies the present cohorts' confident, factional integrity before the reversal.
Rapid forward approach supplies the first convergence's kinetic pattern.
The opposite of slowness supplies the matching speed of the later convergence.
An upright, conspicuous object supplies the single destination that replaces the earlier bilateral center.
Lowering and submission reverse the assertive posture implied by the present rush.
Brokenness under force supplies the social-status reversal at the second destination.

structural_cues: The sequence 70:36-37 and 70:43-44 repeats rapid collective motion but changes center, direction, and posture.
The missing-inventory occurrence و ف ض at 70:43 word 9 is used only as a structural cue for the second rush; no branch citation is assigned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rapid approach, bilateral cohorts, rapid later motion, an upright marker, submission, and brokenness; I infer a kinetic echo that reverses agency. A live alternative is that the shared speed is generic eschatological motion rather than a rehearsal of the focus scene.

changed_reading.before: They choose confident flanking positions around the addressee.
changed_reading.after: Their factional rush pre-enacts a future mustering in which separate flanks collapse toward one imposed destination and confidence becomes abasement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers material containment into social topology. It remains anchored in the focus's containing and reinforced branches plus the context's gather-into-a-vessel sequence; downstream prose should label it a cross-domain resonance, not the lexical meaning of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The people appear as separate reinforced units spread around a center, while the left-side inventory includes fastening a containing cover.

activation_trace.role: A fastened containing cover supplies the material shape transferred, cautiously, to each closed social circle.
Mutual reinforcement supplies the closure and persistence of each social container.
Drawing scattered things together supplies the inward-gathering phase of the material analogy.
Putting a thing into a vessel supplies the enclosing phase, recast as factional crowd architecture.

changed_reading.before: Separate groups happen to occupy the two sides.
changed_reading.after: Each faction behaves like a social vessel, drawing inward and closing over what it claims while the vessels collectively surround the center.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ordinary spatial nouns are heard through oath and witness branches. It remains anchored in the focus's oath-capable right side and opposed left side, then in contextual witnessing and swearing; downstream prose should present it only as a juridical resonance and never replace the primary spatial syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The right-left factions flank a center, and the focus inventory for the right includes the sworn-oath image.

activation_trace.role: The right hand as oath supplies the possible juridical overtone without cancelling the literal side.
The opposed left side supplies the second polarized bench in the exploratory legal geometry.
Presence with direct witnessing supplies the witness-like function tentatively assigned to the flanking factions.
An oath apportioned among its parties confirms that oath-language is active in the nearby context.

changed_reading.before: Spectators cluster on two sides of the addressee.
changed_reading.after: Secondarily, the polarized sides resemble witness benches gathered around an oath that tests their claim.

strongest_changes: 70:36 turns static flanks into converging cohorts centered on the addressee.
70:38 breaks apparent plural solidarity into each person's private claim to admission.
70:40-41 relativize the local surround and expose reinforced cohorts as replaceable.
70:43-44 reverse a chosen factional rush into compelled mustering and abasement.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah is almost pure social geometry: a right-left pair and plural grouping. Context repeatedly changes the center, scale, agency, and cohesion of that geometry without forcing the live readings into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet maps focus ع ز و to an ع ز ز branch inventory, so readings using reinforcement, strength, or prestige are visibly anchored but mapping-dependent.
The kinetic echo with 70:43 is strong, but its status as deliberate rehearsal rather than recurrent motion remains inferential.
The oath-witness and social-container readings should remain qualified exploratory resonances.
